accountability_routes.strategic: ESDM/Minerba issues permitted production plans; downstream demand and export commitments are distinct.
accountability_routes.regulators: Minerba approves/supervises mining plans; industrial incentives are separately administered.
accountability_routes.operators: Operators disclose permits, mine volumes, smelter feedstock and actual output.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR reviews resource policy and associated fiscal performance.
accountability_routes.regional: North Maluku and Sulawesi delivery, water, power and local approvals.
accountability_routes.assessment: Cross-check RKAB with official production statistics and operator output.

accountability_routes.strategic: Industrial downstreaming priorities require sector alignment.
accountability_routes.regulators: ESDM and Kemenperin have different upstream/industrial competencies; BKPM monitors capital.
accountability_routes.operators: Project legal companies fund/build smelters and document commissioning.
accountability_routes.oversight: Parliamentary and audit scrutiny can examine incentives and state stakes.
accountability_routes.regional: Local industrial zones, power and land determine completion.
accountability_routes.assessment: Separate groundbreaking, energized testing and commercial capacity.

accountability_routes.strategic: Concentrate availability, cathode capacity and trade matter.
accountability_routes.regulators: Mining and industry mandates differ across the copper chain.
accountability_routes.operators: PTFI and other operators execute site-specific construction and throughput.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR and financial scrutiny review public-sector exposure.
accountability_routes.regional: East Java and NTB infrastructure interfaces matter.
accountability_routes.assessment: Track actual commercial cathode output, not nameplate.

accountability_routes.strategic: The government sets policy; corporate shareholders govern their own entities.
accountability_routes.regulators: ESDM, BKPM and industrial regulators hold distinct roles.
accountability_routes.operators: State-owned and private SPVs have different shareholders and operators.
accountability_routes.oversight: Listed disclosures and DPR scrutiny provide accountability.
accountability_routes.regional: Permit jurisdiction varies by mine and refinery.
accountability_routes.assessment: Use beneficial-ownership disclosures and specific JV documents.

accountability_routes.strategic: Domestic value added vs trade access is a strategic choice.
accountability_routes.regulators: Legal validity and commodity-specific export instruments live in Policy & Risk.
accountability_routes.operators: Mining companies and processors ship different HS products.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR can review performance and regulatory effects.
accountability_routes.regional: Port, customs and local logistics influence volumes.
accountability_routes.assessment: Separate physical volumes, FOB value and HS classifications.

accountability_routes.regulators: ESDM regulates energy and mineral matters via separate directorates.
accountability_routes.operators: Smelter operators source captive/grid power and cooling inputs.
accountability_routes.oversight: Audit and parliament scrutinize public assets and subsidies.
accountability_routes.regional: Local grid and water capacity condition delivery.
accountability_routes.assessment: Measure facility-specific electricity intensity instead of national guess.

accountability_routes.strategic: Industrial policy coexists with environmental standards.
accountability_routes.regulators: Responsible environment authorities must be established per project.
accountability_routes.operators: Operators disclose approvals, waste and compliance status.
accountability_routes.regional: Local impacts depend on site-specific water and land use.
accountability_routes.assessment: Do not label allegations confirmed without administrative or judicial evidence.

accountability_routes.strategic: Mineral abundance does not imply battery-grade output.
accountability_routes.regulators: Industry and mineral agencies use differing reporting perimeters.
accountability_routes.operators: NPI, matte, MHP and precursors are produced via distinct processes.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR reviews industrial incentives and value capture.
accountability_routes.assessment: Trace mine→product→customer rather than count all nickel as EV materials.

accountability_routes.regulators: BKPM publishes realized investment aggregates; ESDM and Kemenperin supervise sector activity.
accountability_routes.operators: Operators disclose capex and financial milestones where available.
accountability_routes.oversight: State ownership and public finances require appropriate audits.
accountability_routes.regional: Regional delivery and infrastructure impose gates.
accountability_routes.assessment: Do not sum portfolio proposals with realized capex.

accountability_routes.strategic: Komdigi coordinates proposed rules and AI ecosystem priorities.
accountability_routes.regulators: Policy status must be checked against enacted documents; BKPM has a different scope.
accountability_routes.operators: Cloud and AI companies implement practical governance for their services.
accountability_routes.oversight: Oversight involves DPR and appropriate independent authorities.
accountability_routes.regional: Research institutions and local agencies support implementation.
accountability_routes.assessment: Treat drafts as drafts until promulgated.

accountability_routes.strategic: Compute growth depends on available electrical infrastructure.
accountability_routes.regulators: ESDM/PLN separate power regulation, supply contracting and build-out.
accountability_routes.operators: Operators finance, construct, test and energize sites.
accountability_routes.oversight: Public utility oversight and permitting affect public exposure.
accountability_routes.regional: Local grid and land interfaces determine feasibility.
accountability_routes.assessment: Contracted MVA ≠ energised IT MW ≠ GPU capacity.

accountability_routes.strategic: Data protection and cyber resilience are separate policy dimensions.
accountability_routes.regulators: BSSN and competent digital institutions have different powers.
accountability_routes.operators: Site operators handle systems security and incident response.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR and legal institutions oversee statutory rules.
accountability_routes.regional: Public authorities and vendors have site-specific duties.
accountability_routes.assessment: Check enforceable articles, reporting and actual audits.

accountability_routes.strategic: Connectivity and power proximity to Singapore creates options, not guaranteed delivery.
accountability_routes.regulators: BP Batam and national digital/energy agencies cover different jurisdictions.
accountability_routes.operators: Commercial campuses procure land, energy and fiber.
accountability_routes.oversight: Investment transparency and contract compliance require scrutiny.
accountability_routes.regional: Local government and connectivity infrastructure are decisive.
accountability_routes.assessment: Require commissioned site, grid and route records.

accountability_routes.strategic: Availability of cloud services is distinct from AI GPU inventory.
accountability_routes.regulators: Digital governance and data handling fall under applicable rules.
accountability_routes.operators: Hyperscalers and colocation operators sell different services.
accountability_routes.oversight: Procurement scrutiny and competition policy may matter.
accountability_routes.regional: Application developers and academia need usable access.
accountability_routes.assessment: Do not infer GPUs from a cloud-region launch.

accountability_routes.strategic: R&D capacity is a national capability criterion.
accountability_routes.regulators: Komdigi, education and R&D institutions have distinct mandates.
accountability_routes.operators: Cloud providers, universities and firms provide actual training resources.
accountability_routes.oversight: Program funding and results need review.
accountability_routes.regional: Regional universities and research centers affect skills.
accountability_routes.assessment: Count delivered training/certification and compute use.

accountability_routes.strategic: National investment attractiveness does not establish industry realized capex.
accountability_routes.regulators: BKPM investment accounting differs from power/ICT regulatory mandates.
accountability_routes.operators: Site operators disclose construction, financing and service milestones.
accountability_routes.oversight: Public disclosure, audit and competition oversight apply case by case.
accountability_routes.assessment: Avoid adding financing and project budgets to national BKPM figures.

accountability_routes.regulators: Telecom authorities govern networks under relevant legal instruments.
accountability_routes.operators: Telin, independent carriers and site operators establish routes.
accountability_routes.oversight: DPR scrutiny relates to applicable digital legislation.
accountability_routes.regional: Landing stations and regional service quality matter.
accountability_routes.assessment: Track routes and SLA, not only announced fiber capacity.

accountability_routes.strategic: Compute sovereignty depends on hardware access and efficient operations.
accountability_routes.regulators: Trade, digital and energy agencies have different roles.
accountability_routes.operators: GPU vendors, hyperscalers and local service companies execute procurements.
accountability_routes.oversight: Public procurement integrity and security due diligence matter.
accountability_routes.regional: Skilled operations and spare-part availability affect uptime.
accountability_routes.assessment: Distinguish installed hardware, contracted compute and expected shipments.
